items.html: And what I say — that the Keter of the Keter was revealed in the lowest rank — you did not take my words precisely, for there are only thirteen corrections of the beard alone, and they are not twenty. But the intention is to say that the highest rank within the Keter, which is called "Venakeh" ["and He will clear"], which is the Hesed, was revealed in a lower rank, as will be explained, with God's help.
